payload.title: Test Qwen-native vision-feature reuse against separate Retina feature backbone on the final target VPS
payload.work_clay: Implement an H1-grade matched visual benchmark around the current Qwen3.5-4B abliterated Q4_K_M + mmproj lane on the Frank v0.1 target VPS. Capture the libmtmd image embedding buffer before LLM decode, derive deterministic pooled MVC-Q0 descriptors and optionally a bounded MVC-Q1 linear projection/readout, then compare FULL_QWEN, current dedicated-feature MVC baseline, QNDRF feature reuse, QNDRF ROI/token-budget and action-grounded-memory variants. On escalation, prove whether the already-computed mtmd embeddings can be passed into the same Qwen decode without rerunning visual encoding. Treat visual sensor origin as independent from the compute host: frozen screenshot/crop fixtures may be local files, while live screen/camera/browser sources must enter through provenance-bound sensor ingress. Separate sensor/network ingress latency from on-VPS Retina/Qwen latency. Preserve exact target-host/source/model/mmproj hashes, image token counts, frame/ROI identity, latency, CPU/RAM/swap/storage/network and GPU/VRAM only if actually present, false-familiarity/open-set metrics, task/action outcome correctness and crash/replay receipts.
payload.reason_clay: Fresh primary evidence shows Qwen3.5-4B is already natively multimodal; Transformers exposes get_image_features before text decoding; llama.cpp libmtmd exposes encoded media embeddings and current llama-server feeds that same embedding buffer into the LLM. Existing target-host evidence also proves the Hostinger VPS can execute a real local 4B Qwen-family model. Because the project owner has now made this VPS the final v0.1 target, the differential must be judged by target-VPS end-to-end performance rather than treating Hostinger results as proxy-only. Counterevidence from multimodal embedding research still means raw generative-VLM features cannot be assumed to be good prototype/open-set embeddings, so a matched dedicated-feature baseline remains mandatory.
payload.completion_clay: A reproducible target-VPS report and raw rows compare all frozen variants on identical screenshot/crop/action fixtures. The report separately measures sensor ingress where applicable, mmproj encode cost, 4B decode cost and total target-VPS sensor-to-decision cost; proves or falsifies zero-duplicate visual encoding on escalation; reports familiar/unknown/ambiguous/conflict calibration; measures ROI/context failure modes including off-ROI modal changes and small-text OCR; performs stale feature-version and crash/restart tests; and gives SUPPORTED, REVISE, REFUTED or NO_CHANGE disposition for deleting a separate heavy visual backbone. The accepted target-host rows are final-target performance evidence but do not by themselves grant H1/H2/H3 or BASE release credit.
payload.executor_policy: Execute the primary performance/correctness differential on the current verified Hostinger target VPS because it is now the Frank v0.1 final target host. Do not describe target-VPS rows as merely CPU-only proxy evidence. If the target VPS has no GPU, that is the real v0.1 constraint unless the owner explicitly switches the target or authorizes a remote accelerator architecture. Use frozen visual fixtures to isolate compute-path effects; measure live sensor transport separately when present. Do not displace the BASE ClayCode critical path unless this benchmark directly unblocks H1 planning and spare capacity is unavailable. Refresh canonical/head, active work, target-host identity, model/runtime versions and official llama.cpp multimodal API before effect. No paid training. No model promotion from generic benchmarks alone.
invalidators: Project owner explicitly changes the final Frank v0.1 target host
A newer owner-fixed visual architecture explicitly supersedes dissolved perception or MVC requirements
A newer target-VPS execution receipt already proves the same Qwen-feature-reuse differential on the current model/mmproj/runtime
Current Frank model/runtime no longer uses a Qwen3.5 multimodal path compatible with libmtmd feature interception
